title: Basic supply kit
items: Water: 1 gallon per person per day for several days
Food: at least a several-day supply of non-perishables
Battery or hand-crank radio, plus NOAA Weather Radio with tone alert
Flashlight and extra batteries
First aid kit
Whistle (to signal for help)
Dust mask
Plastic sheeting, scissors, duct tape
Moist towelettes, garbage bags, plastic ties (sanitation)
Wrench or pliers (to turn off utilities)
Manual can opener
Local maps (paper backup to the app)
Cell phone with chargers and a backup battery

title: Add as needed
items: Soap, hand sanitizer, disinfecting wipes
Prescription medications, glasses
OTC meds (pain relievers, anti-diarrhea, antacids)
Pet food and extra water for the dog
Cash
Copies of important documents (waterproof container or saved electronically)
Sleeping bag or blanket, change of clothes, sturdy shoes
Fire extinguisher, matches in a waterproof container, hygiene supplies

title: Before the storm
items: Sign up for AlertLake (Lake County alerts) while the grid is up
A camper is not a safe place to ride out a hurricane: treat any hurricane warning as "leave"
Pick where you and the dog will go (pet-friendly shelter, friends or family, or a solid building) and save it in My Plan
Confirm which shelters are open for this storm (openings change each event)
Charge phone and power banks
Fill the truck's gas tank
Pack the kit and the dog's food, water and papers
Secure trash, pet food and food scraps (black bears)
